summary: The gyomu-cli package serves as the core command-line interface for the application, leveraging Typer to provide entry points, command execution, and routing registration. It coordinates user-facing commands like greetings and snapshots while relying on supporting domain and workflow packages for underlying operations.
responsibilities: Define and expose the primary CLI entry points and user commands.
Handle command routing and feature registration for the CLI application.
Coordinate with shared domain and infrastructure packages to execute commands.

capabilities.name: Command Line Interface
capabilities.description: Provides the main entry point and executable command structure for the CLI application.

capabilities.name: Routing and Registration
capabilities.description: Organizes command routing and application feature registration.

capabilities.name: System Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates with underlying workflow, schema, and infrastructure packages.

design_decisions: Uses Typer to build a structured, attribute-based command line interface.
Modularizes command handling around core application domains such as greetings and snapshots.
Depends on external domain packages (gyomu-schema, gyomu-infra, gyomu-workflow) to delegate business logic execution.
usage_guidance: Use the main application entry points defined in the package to execute CLI commands.
Register new command routes using the established routing mechanisms within the application structure.
